records.descriptor: Office/outpatient visit, established patient, low-level medical decision making (about 20-29 minutes).
Office/outpatient visit, established patient, moderate-level medical decision making (about 30-39 minutes).
Emergency department visit, high-complexity medical decision making.
Periodic preventive medicine visit, established patient, ages 18-39.
Layered (intermediate) repair of a wound of the scalp, trunk, or extremities, 2.5 cm or less.
Excision of a benign skin lesion of the trunk, arm, or leg, 1.1-2.0 cm.
Total knee arthroplasty (replacement of both the femoral and tibial articular surfaces).
Flexible colonoscopy examining to the cecum; base code used for a screening colonoscopy.
Flexible colonoscopy with biopsy of one or more lesions (diagnostic).
MRI of a lower-extremity joint (e.g., knee) without contrast material.
Chest X-ray, two views (frontal and lateral).
CT scan of the chest without contrast material.
Comprehensive metabolic panel (a defined set of 14 blood chemistry tests).
Complete blood count (CBC) with automated differential white-cell count.
Administration of an influenza virus vaccine.
Annual wellness visit, initial — includes a personalized prevention plan of service.
Unclassified drug (used when no specific HCPCS drug code exists).
Blood glucose test strips for home monitoring, per 50 strips.
Essential (primary) hypertension.
Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications.
